title: Entity Behavior Document
description: A behavior pack entity definition document for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. This describes the complete JSON file structure including format_version and the minecraft:entity wrapper.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this entity behavior file. Determines which features and component schemas are available.

minecraft:entity.title: Entity Definition
minecraft:entity.description:
The entity definition container with all behavior pack entity data.

Properties:
• component_groups = {}
• components (object)
• description (object)
• events

defaultSnippets.label: Entity Actor Document
defaultSnippets.description: The root structure for entity behavior definitions in behavior packs. Contains the entity's unique identifier, components that define its capabilities, component groups for state variations, and events that trigger state changes. Every custom mob, NPC, or creature requires an actor document defining its AI, health, movement, and interactions.

entity_rider_data.title: Entity Rider Data
entity_rider_data.description: List of riders to be added to the entity. Must have no more riders than "minecraft:rideable" has "seat_count".

entity_type.title: Entity Type
entity_type.description: The entity type that will be riding this entity.

spawn_event.title: Spawn Event
spawn_event.description: The spawn event that will be used when the riding entity is created.

entity_minecraft_addrider.title: Add Rider
entity_minecraft_addrider.description: Adds a rider to the entity.

entity_type.title: Entity type to ride
entity_type.description: Type of entity to acquire as a rider

spawn_event.title: Spawn Event
spawn_event.description: Trigger event when a rider is acquired

riders.title: Riders
riders.description:
List of riders to be added to the entity. Can only spawn as many riders as "minecraft:rideable" has "seat_count".

Properties:
• entity_type (string)
• spawn_event (string) = 

Sample values:
• cave_spider: [{"entity_type":"minecraft:bogged"}]
• cave_spider: [{"entity_type":"minecraft:wither_skeleton"}]

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration, in seconds, that the mob is pacified.

entity_minecraft_ageable.title: Ageable
entity_minecraft_ageable.description: Adds a timer for the entity to grow up. It can be accelerated by giving the entity the items it likes as defined by feed_items.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description:
Length of time before an entity grows up (-1 to always stay a baby)

Sample values:
• chicken: 1200

feed_items.title: Feed Items
feed_items.description:
List of items that can be fed to an entity to age them up. Can be a single item string or an array of items.

Sample values:
• chicken: ["wheat_seeds","beetroot_seeds","melon_seeds","...
• cow: wheat
• dolphin: ["fish","salmon"]

drop_items.title: Drop Items
drop_items.description: List of items that are dropped when an entity grows up

grow_up.title: Grow up event
grow_up.description:
Event to fire when an entity grows up. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

Sample values:
• chicken: {"event":"minecraft:ageable_grow_up","target":"...
• dolphin: {"event":"ageable_grow_up","target":"self"}

interact_filters.title: Interact Filters
interact_filters.description: List of conditions to meet so that the entity can be fed.

pause_growth_items.title: Pause Growth Items
pause_growth_items.description:
List of items that can be fed to the entity to pause growth for baby entities.

Sample values:
• chicken: ["golden_dandelion"]

reset_growth_items.title: Reset Growth Items
reset_growth_items.description:
List of items that can be used to reset growth for baby entities.

Sample values:
• chicken: ["golden_dandelion"]

entity_minecraft_ambient_sound_interval.title: Ambient Sound Interval
entity_minecraft_ambient_sound_interval.description: Delay for an entity playing its sound

event_name.title: Event Name
event_name.description:
Level sound event to be played as the ambient sound.

Sample values:
• allay: ambient
• fox: sleep
• fox: screech

event_names.title: Event Names
event_names.description:
List of dynamic level sound events, with conditions for choosing between them. Evaluated in order, first one wins. If none evaluate to true, 'event_name' will take precedence.

Properties:
• condition (string)
• event_name (string)

Sample values:
• allay: [{"condition":"query.is_using_item","event_name...
• warden: [{"condition":"query.anger_level(this) >= 80","...

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: The condition that must be satisfied to select the given ambient sound

event_name.title: Event Name
event_name.description: Level sound event to be played as the ambient sound

range.title: Range
range.description:
Maximum time in seconds to randomly add to the ambient sound delay time.

Sample values:
• allay: 5
• fox: 160
• warden: 4

value.title: Value
value.description:
Minimum time in seconds before the entity plays its ambient sound again.

Sample values:
• allay: 5
• fox: 80
• warden: 2

on_increase_sounds.title: On Increase Sounds
on_increase_sounds.description:
Sounds to play when the entity is getting provoked. Evaluated in order. First matching condition wins

condition.title: Condition

max_anger.title: Max Anger
max_anger.description:

entity_minecraft_annotation_open_door.title: Open doors annotation

entity_minecraft_area_attack.title: Area Attack
entity_minecraft_area_attack.description: A component that does damage to entities that get within range.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description:
The type of damage that is applied to entities that enter the damage range. A list of available damage sources can be found at [Entity Damage Sources located in the Vanilla Listings Documentation](../../VanillaListingsReference/AddonEntityDamageSources.md).

Sample values:

The set of entities that are valid to apply the damage to when within range.

damage_per_tick.title: Damage Per Tick

How much damage per tick is applied to entities that enter the damage range.

Sample values:

damage_range.title: Damage Range
damage_range.description:
How close a hostile entity must be to have the damage applied.

damage_cooldown.title: Damage Cooldown
damage_cooldown.description:
Attack cooldown (in seconds) for how often this entity can attack a target.

play_attack_sound.title: Play Attack Sound
play_attack_sound.description: If the entity should play their attack sound when attacking a target.

entity_minecraft_attack.title: Attack
entity_minecraft_attack.description: Defines an entity's melee attack damage and any additional status effects applied on hit. Typical damage values range from 3 (zombie, creeper) to 7-21 (iron golem).

damage.title: Damage
damage.description: Range of the random amount of damage the melee attack deals. A negative value can heal the entity instead of hurting it. Can be a number, an array [min, max], or an object with range_min and range_max properties.

effect_duration.title: Effect Duration
effect_duration.description: Duration in seconds of the status ailment applied to the damaged entity.

effect_name.title: Effect Name
effect_name.description: Identifier of the status ailment to apply to an entity attacked by this entity's melee attack.

entity_minecraft_attack_cooldown.title: Attack Cooldown
entity_minecraft_attack_cooldown.description: Adds a cooldown to an entity. The intention of this cooldown is to be used to prevent the entity from attempting to acquire new attack targets.

attack_cooldown_complete_event.title: Attack Cooldown Complete Event
attack_cooldown_complete_event.description: Event to be run when the cooldown is complete. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

attack_cooldown_time.title: Attack Cooldown Time
attack_cooldown_time.description: Amount of time in seconds for the cooldown. Can be specified as a number or a pair of numbers (min and max).

entity_minecraft_attack_damage.title: Attack Damage
entity_minecraft_attack_damage.description: Specifies how much damage is dealt by the entity when it attacks.

value.description: How much an attack should damage a target.

on_unballoon.description: Event to call when this entity is unballooned.

mass.description: Mass that this entity will have when computing balloon pull forces.

• filters
• max_dist (float) = 16
• must_see (boolean) = false
• must_see_forget_duration (float) = 3

conditional_values.title: Conditional Values
conditional_values.description:
The object containing the conditional bandwidth optimization values.

Properties:
• conditional_values
• max_dropped_ticks (int) = 10
• max_optimized_distance (float) = 80
• use_motion_prediction_hints (boolean) = false

conditional_values.title: Conditional Values
conditional_values.description: Conditions that must be met for these optimization values to be used.

max_dropped_ticks.title: Max Dropped Ticks
max_dropped_ticks.description: In relation to the optimization value, determines the maximum ticks spatial update packets can be not sent.

max_optimized_distance.title: Max Optimized Distance
max_optimized_distance.description: The maximum distance considered during bandwidth optimizations. Any value below the max is interpolated to find optimization, and any value greater than or equal to this max results in max optimization.

use_motion_prediction_hints.title: Use Motion Prediction Hints
use_motion_prediction_hints.description: When set to true, smaller motion packets will be sent during drop packet intervals, resulting in the same amount of packets being sent as without optimizations but with much less data being sent. This should be used when actors are travelling very quickly or teleporting to prevent visual oddities.

entity_minecraft_custom_hit_test.title: Custom Hit Test
entity_minecraft_custom_hit_test.description: List of hitboxes for melee and ranged hits against the entity.

hitboxes.title: Hitboxes
hitboxes.description:
Comma-separated list of hitboxes.

Sample values:
• hoglin: [{"width":1,"height":0.85,"pivot":[0,0.5,0]}]
• hoglin: [{"width":2,"height":1.75,"pivot":[0,1,0]}]
• zoglin: [{"height":1.75,"pivot":[0,1,0],"width":2}]

entity_minecraft_damage_over_time.title: Damage Over Time
entity_minecraft_damage_over_time.description: Applies defined amount of damage to the entity at specified intervals.

damage_per_hurt.title: Damage Per Hurt
damage_per_hurt.description:
Amount of damage caused each hurt.

time_between_hurt.title: Time Between Hurt
time_between_hurt.description:
Time in seconds between damage.

Sample values:
• vex: 1

entity_minecraft_damage_sensor.title: Damage Sensor
entity_minecraft_damage_sensor.description: Defines what events to call when this entity is damaged by specific entities or items.

deals_damage.title: Deals Damage
deals_damage.description:
Defines how received damage affects the entity.

Values:
• yes: Received damage is applied to the entity.
• no: Received damage is not applied to the entity.
• no_but_side_effects_apply: Received damage is not applied to the entity, but the side effects of the attack are. This means that the attacker's weapon loses durability, enchantment side effects are applied, and so on.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: Type of damage that triggers the events.

damage_modifier.title: Damage Modifier
damage_modifier.description: A modifier that adds/removes to the base damage received from the specified damage cause.

damage_multiplier.title: Damage Multiplier
damage_multiplier.description: A multiplier that modifies the base damage received from the specified damage cause.

deals_damage.title: Deals Damage
deals_damage.description: Defines how received damage affects the entity.

defaultSnippets.label: Deals Damage: true (enable)
defaultSnippets.description: Defines how received damage affects the entity.

defaultSnippets.label: Deals Damage: false (disable)
defaultSnippets.description: Defines how received damage affects the entity.

on_damage.title: On Damage
on_damage.description: Defines which entities the trigger applies to, and which event to emit when damaged.

on_damage_sound_event.title: Damage Sound Event
on_damage_sound_event.description: Defines what sound to play when the on_damage filters are met.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filter conditions for when this trigger applies.

event.title: Event
event.description: Event to emit when the trigger conditions are met.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description:
List of triggers with the events to call when taking specific kinds of damage.

Properties:
• cause (string) = none
• damage_modifier (float) = 0
• damage_multiplier (float) = 1
• deals_damage (boolean) = false
• on_damage
• on_damage_sound_event
• filters
• event (string)

Sample values:
• allay: [{"deals_damage":"no","on_damage":{"filters":{"...
• bat: {"cause":"fall","deals_damage":"no"}
• breeze: [{"cause":"fall","deals_damage":"no"},{"cause":...

entity_minecraft_dash.title: Dash
entity_minecraft_dash.description: Ability for a rideable entity to dash.

The dash cooldown in seconds. Default value is 1.000000.

horizontal_momentum.title: Horizontal Momentum
horizontal_momentum.description:
Horizontal momentum of the dash.

vertical_momentum.title: Vertical Momentum
vertical_momentum.description:
Vertical momentum of the dash.

• camel: 0.6

entity_minecraft_default_look_angle.title: Default Look Angle
entity_minecraft_default_look_angle.description: Sets this entity's default head rotation angle.

value.title: Value
value.description: Angle in degrees.

entity_minecraft_despawn.title: Despawn
entity_minecraft_despawn.description: Despawns the Actor when the despawn rules or optional filters evaluate to true.

despawn_from_distance.title: Despawn From Distance
despawn_from_distance.description:
Specifies if the 'min_distance' and 'max_distance' are used in the standard despawn rules.

Properties:
• max_distance (int) = 128
• min_distance (int) = 32

Sample values:
• bat: {}

max_distance.title: Max Distance
max_distance.description: Maximum distance for standard despawn rules to instantly despawn the mob.

min_distance.title: Min Distance
min_distance.description: Minimum distance for standard despawn rules to try to despawn the mob.

defaultSnippets.label: Despawn From Distance
defaultSnippets.description: Specifies if the 'min_distance' and 'max_distance' are used in the standard despawn rules.

despawn_from_chance.title: Despawn From Chance
despawn_from_chance.description: Determines if "min_range_random_chance" is used in the standard despawn rules

despawn_from_inactivity.title: Despawn From Inactivity
despawn_from_inactivity.description: Determines if the "min_range_inactivity_timer" is used in the standard despawn rules.

despawn_from_simulation_edge.title: Despawn From Simulation Edge
despawn_from_simulation_edge.description: Determines if the mob is instantly despawned at the edge of simulation distance in the standard despawn rules.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: The list of conditions that must be satisfied before the Actor is despawned. If a filter is defined then standard despawn rules are ignored.

min_range_inactivity_timer.title: Min Range Inactivity Timer
min_range_inactivity_timer.description: The amount of time in seconds that the mob must be inactive.

min_range_random_chance.title: Min Range Random Chance
min_range_random_chance.description: A random chance between 1 and the given value.

remove_child_entities.title: Remove Child Entities
remove_child_entities.description: If true, all entities linked to this entity in a child relationship (eg. leashed) will also be despawned.

entity_minecraft_dimension_bound.title: Dimension Bound
entity_minecraft_dimension_bound.description: Prevents the entity from changing dimension through portals.

entity_minecraft_drying_out_timer.title: Drying Out Timer
entity_minecraft_drying_out_timer.description: Adds a timer for drying out that will count down and fire 'dried_out_event' or will stop as soon as the entity will get under rain or water and fire 'stopped_drying_out_event'

dried_out_event.title: Dried Out Event

recover_after_dried_out_event.title: Recover After Dried Out Event

stopped_drying_out_event.title: Stopped Drying Out Event

total_time.title: Total Time
total_time.description:
Amount of time in seconds to dry out fully.

Sample values:
• dolphin: 120

water_bottle_refill_time.title: Water Bottle Refill Time
water_bottle_refill_time.description: Optional amount of additional time in seconds given by using splash water bottle on entity.

entity_minecraft_dweller.title: Dweller
entity_minecraft_dweller.description: Compels an entity to join and migrate between villages and other dwellings.

dwelling_type.title: Dwelling Type
dwelling_type.description:
The type of dwelling the entity wishes to join. Current Types: village.

Sample values:
• iron_golem: village

dwelling_role.title: Dwelling Role
dwelling_role.description: The role of which the entity plays in the dwelling. Current Roles: inhabitant, defender, hostile, passive.

update_interval_base.title: Update Interval Base
update_interval_base.description:
How often the entity checks on their dwelling status in ticks. Positive values only.

Sample values:
• iron_golem: 60

update_interval_variant.title: Update Interval Variant
update_interval_variant.description:
The variant value in ticks that will be added to the update_interval_base.

Sample values:
• iron_golem: 40

can_find_poi.title: Can find POI
can_find_poi.description: Whether or not the entity can find and add POIs to the dwelling.

first_founding_reward.title: First Founding Reward
first_founding_reward.description: Determines how much reputation players are rewarded on first founding.

can_migrate.title: Can Migrate
can_migrate.description:
Determines whether the entity can migrate between dwellings, or only have its initial dwelling.

Sample values:
• iron_golem: true

dwelling_bounds_tolerance.title: Dwelling Bounds Tolerance
dwelling_bounds_tolerance.description: A padding distance for checking if the entity is within the dwelling.

preferred_profession.title: Preferred Profession
preferred_profession.description: Allows the user to define a starting profession for this particular Dweller, instead of letting them choose organically. (They still need to gain experience from trading before this takes effect.)

entity_minecraft_economy_trade_table.title: Economy Trade Table
entity_minecraft_economy_trade_table.description: Defines this entity's ability to trade with players.

convert_trades_economy.title: Convert Trades Economy
convert_trades_economy.description: Determines when the mob transforms, if the trades should be converted when the new mob has a economy_trade_table. When the trades are converted, the mob will generate a new trade list with their new trade table, but then it will try to convert any of the same trades over to have the same enchantments and user data. For example, if the original has a Emerald to Enchanted Iron Sword (Sharpness 1), and the new trade also has an Emerald for Enchanted Iron Sword, then the enchantment will be Sharpness 1.

cured_discount.title: Cured Discount
cured_discount.description: How much should the discount be modified by when the player has cured the Zombie Villager. Can be specified as a pair of numbers (When use_legacy_price_formula is true this is the low-tier trade discount and high-tier trade discount, otherwise it is the minor positive gossip and major positive gossip.)

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Name to be displayed while trading with this entity

hero_demand_discount.title: Hero Demand Discount
hero_demand_discount.description: Used in legacy prices to determine how much should Demand be modified by when the player has the Hero of the Village mob effect

max_cured_discount.title: Max Cured Discount
max_cured_discount.description: The max the discount can be modified by when the player has cured the Zombie Villager. Can be specified as a pair of numbers (When use_legacy_price_formula is true this is the low-tier trade discount and high-tier trade discount, otherwise it is the minor positive gossip and major positive gossip.)

max_nearby_cured_discount.title: Max Nearby Cured Discount
max_nearby_cured_discount.description: The max the discount can be modified by when the player has cured a nearby Zombie Villager. Only used when use_legacy_price_formula is true, otherwise max_cured_discount (low) is used.

nearby_cured_discount.title: Nearby Cured Discount
nearby_cured_discount.description: How much should the discount be modified by when the player has cured a nearby Zombie Villager

new_screen.title: New Screen
new_screen.description: Used to determine if trading with entity opens the new trade screen

persist_trades.title: Persist Trades
persist_trades.description: Determines if the trades should persist when the mob transforms. This makes it so that the next time the mob is transformed to something with a trade_table or economy_trade_table, then it keeps their trades.

show_trade_screen.title: Show Trade Screen
show_trade_screen.description: Show an in game trade screen when interacting with the mob.

table.title: Table
table.description: File path relative to the resource pack root for this entity's trades

use_legacy_price_formula.title: Use Legacy Price Formula
use_legacy_price_formula.description: Determines whether the legacy formula is used to determines the trade prices.

entity_minecraft_entity_armor_equipment_.title: Entity Armor Equipment Slot Mapping
entity_minecraft_entity_armor_equipment_.description: It defines to which armor slot an item equipped to 'minecraft:equippable''s second slot should be equipped to. It is automatically applied to all entities for worlds with a version greater than or equal to 1.21.10. For older worlds, 'slot.armor.torso' will be used. It is strongly advised not to explicitly use this component, as no backwards compatibility for it will be provided.

armor_slot.title: Armor Slot
armor_slot.description: The armor slot an item equipped to 'minecraft:equippable''s second slot should be equipped to. It defaults to 'slot.armor.torso' for entities with a format version prior to 1.21.10, and to 'slot.armor.body' otherwise.

entity_minecraft_entity_sensor.title: Entity Sensor
entity_minecraft_entity_sensor.description: A component that owns multiple subsensors, each one firing an event when a set of conditions are met by other entities within the defined range.

find_players_only.title: Find Players Only
find_players_only.description: Limits the search to Players only for all subsensors.

relative_range.title: Relative Range
relative_range.description: If true the subsensors' range is additive on top of the entity's size.

subsensors.title: Subsensors
subsensors.description:
The list of subsensors which sense for entities and emit events when all their conditions are met.

Properties:
• cooldown (float) = -1
• event
• event_filters
• maximum_count (int) = -1
• minimum_count (int) = 1
• range = [10, 10]
• require_all (boolean) = false
• y_offset (float) = 0

Sample values:
• parrot: [{"event":"minecraft:on_riding_player","event_f...
• parrot: [{"event":"minecraft:on_not_riding_player","eve...

cooldown.title: Cooldown
cooldown.description: How many seconds should elapse before the subsensor can once again sense for entities. The cooldown is applied on top of the base 1 tick (0.05 seconds) delay. Negative values will result in no cooldown being used.

event.title: Event
event.description: Event to fire when the conditions are met.

event_filters.title: Event Filters
event_filters.description: The set of conditions that must be satisfied to fire the event.

maximum_count.title: Maximum Count
maximum_count.description: The maximum number of entities that must pass the filter conditions for the event to send.

minimum_count.title: Minimum Count
minimum_count.description: The minimum number of entities that must pass the filter conditions for the event to send.

range.title: Range
range.description: The maximum horizontal and vertical distance another entity can be from this and have the filters checked against it.

require_all.title: Require All
require_all.description: If true requires all nearby entities to pass the filter conditions for the events to send.

y_offset.title: y Offset
y_offset.description: Vertical offset applied to the entity's position when computing the distance from other entities.

entity_minecraft_environment_sensor.title: Environment Sensor
entity_minecraft_environment_sensor.description: Creates a trigger based on environment conditions.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description:
The list of triggers that fire when the environment conditions match the given filter criteria. Can be an array of trigger objects or a single trigger object.

Sample values:
• breeze: [{"event":"minecraft:stop_playing_idle_ground_s...
• cave_spider: {"event":"minecraft:become_neutral","filters":{...
• cave_spider: {"event":"minecraft:become_hostile","filters":{...

entity_minecraft_equip_item.description: The entity puts on the desired equipment.

can_wear_armor.title: Can Wear Armor
can_wear_armor.description: If true, the entity can pick up and wear armor items from the ground.

entity_minecraft_equipment.title: Equipment
entity_minecraft_equipment.description: Sets the Equipment table to use for this Entity.

drop_chance.title: Drop Chance
drop_chance.description: The chance to drop the equipped item (0.0 to 1.0).

slot_drop_chance.title: Slot Drop Chance
slot_drop_chance.description: A list of slots with the chance to drop an equipped item from that slot. Can be an array of slot name strings or an array of objects with slot and drop_chance properties.

table.title: Table
table.description: The file path to the equipment table, relative to the behavior pack's root.

entity_minecraft_equippable.title: Equippable
entity_minecraft_equippable.description: Defines an entity's behavior for having items equipped to it.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description:
List of slots and the item that can be equipped.

accepted_items.title: Accepted Items
accepted_items.description: The list of items that can go in this slot.

interact_text.title: Interact Text
interact_text.description: Text to be displayed when the entity can be equipped with this item when playing with Touch-screen controls.

item.title: Item
item.description: Identifier of the item that can be equipped for this slot.

on_equip.title: Equip
on_equip.description: Event to trigger when this entity is equipped with this item.

on_unequip.title: Unequip
on_unequip.description: Event to trigger when this item is removed from this entity.

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: The slot number of this slot.

toggles_blocks.title: Toggles Blocks
toggles_blocks.description:
If true, the explosion will toggle blocks in the explosion radius.

*Introduced in version 1.21.40*

Sample values:
• breeze_wind_charge_projectile: true

knockback_scaling.title: Knockback Scaling
knockback_scaling.description:
A scale factor applied to the knockback force caused by the explosion.

*Introduced in version 1.21.40*

Sample values:
• breeze_wind_charge_projectile: 0.6
• wind_charge_projectile: 1.22

particle_effect.title: Particle Effect
particle_effect.description:
The name of the particle effect to use. The accepted strings are 'explosion', 'wind_burst', or 'breeze_wind_burst'.

*Introduced in version 1.21.40*

Sample values:
• breeze_wind_charge_projectile: breeze_wind_burst
• wind_charge_projectile: wind_burst

sound_effect.title: Sound Effect
sound_effect.description:
The name of the sound effect played when the explosion triggers.

*Introduced in version 1.21.40*

Sample values:
• breeze_wind_charge_projectile: breeze_wind_charge.burst
• wind_charge_projectile: wind_charge.burst

negates_fall_damage.title: Negates Fall Damage
negates_fall_damage.description:
Defines whether the explosion should apply fall damage negation to Players above the point of collision.

*Introduced in version 1.21.40*

Sample values:
• wind_charge_projectile: true

allow_underwater.title: Allow Underwater
allow_underwater.description:
If true, the explosion will affect blocks and entities under water.

*Introduced in version 1.21.40*

Sample values:
• breeze_wind_charge_projectile: true

breaks_blocks.title: Breaks Blocks
breaks_blocks.description: If true, the explosion will destroy blocks in the explosion radius.

causes_fire.title: Causes Fire
causes_fire.description:
If true, blocks in the explosion radius will be set on fire.

Sample values:
• fireball: true

damage_scaling.title: Damage Scaling
damage_scaling.description: A scale factor applied to the explosion's damage to entities. A value of 0 prevents the explosion from dealing any damage. Negative values cause the explosion to heal entities instead.

destroy_affected_by_griefing.title: Destroy Affected By Griefing
destroy_affected_by_griefing.description:
If true, whether the explosion breaks blocks is affected by the mob griefing game rule.

Sample values:
• ender_crystal: true

fire_affected_by_griefing.title: Fire Affected By Griefing
fire_affected_by_griefing.description:
If true, whether the explosion causes fire is affected by the mob griefing game rule.

Sample values:
• fireball: true

fuse_length.title: Fuse Length
fuse_length.description:
The range for the random amount of time the fuse will be lit before exploding, a negative value means the explosion will be immediate.

Sample values:

fuse_lit.title: Fuse Lit
fuse_lit.description:
If true, the fuse is already lit when this component is added to the entity.

Sample values:
• ender_crystal: true

max_resistance.title: Max Resistance
max_resistance.description: A blocks explosion resistance will be capped at this value when an explosion occurs.

power.title: Power
power.description:
The radius of the explosion in blocks and the amount of damage the explosion deals.

Sample values:
• breeze_wind_charge_projectile: 3
• ender_crystal: 6
• fireball: 1

entity_minecraft_fire_immune.title: Fire Immune
entity_minecraft_fire_immune.description: Sets that this entity doesn't take damage from fire.

entity_minecraft_floats_in_liquid.title: Floats In Liquid
entity_minecraft_floats_in_liquid.description: Sets that this entity can float in liquid blocks.

entity_minecraft_flocking.title: Flocking
entity_minecraft_flocking.description: Allows entities to flock in groups in water or not.

block_distance.title: Block Distance
block_distance.description:
The amount of blocks away the entity will look at to push away from.

block_weight.title: Block Weight
block_weight.description: The weight of the push back away from blocks.

breach_influence.title: Breach Influence
breach_influence.description: The amount of push back given to a flocker that breaches out of the water.

cohesion_threshold.title: Cohesion Threshold
cohesion_threshold.description:
The threshold in which to start applying cohesion.

cohesion_weight.title: Cohesion Weight
cohesion_weight.description:
The weight applied for the cohesion steering of the flock.

goal_weight.title: Goal Weight
goal_weight.description:
The weight on which to apply on the goal output.

Sample values:

high_flock_limit.title: High Flock Limit
high_flock_limit.description:
Determines the high bound amount of entities that can be allowed in the flock.

in_water.title: In Water
in_water.description: Tells the Flocking Component if the entity exists in water.

influence_radius.title: Influence Radius
influence_radius.description:
The area around the entity that allows others to be added to the flock.

innner_cohesion_threshold.title: Innner Cohesion Threshold
innner_cohesion_threshold.description:
The distance in which the flocker will stop applying cohesion.

loner_chance.title: Loner Chance
loner_chance.description:

low_flock_limit.title: Low Flock Limit
low_flock_limit.description:
Determines the low bound amount of entities that can be allowed in the flock.

match_variants.title: Match Variants
match_variants.description: Tells the flockers that they can only match similar entities that also match the variant, mark variants, and color data of the other potential flockers.

max_height.title: Max Height
max_height.description:
The max height allowable in the air or water.

min_height.title: Min Height
min_height.description:
The min height allowable in the air or water.

separation_threshold.title: Separation Threshold
separation_threshold.description:
The distance that is determined to be to close to another flocking and to start applying separation.

separation_weight.title: Separation Weight
separation_weight.description:
The weight applied to the separation of the flock.

use_center_of_mass.title: Use Center Of Mass
use_center_of_mass.description: Tells the flockers that they will follow flocks based on the center of mass.

entity_minecraft_flying_speed.title: Flying Speed
entity_minecraft_flying_speed.description: Speed in Blocks that this entity flies at.

Flying speed in blocks per tick.

• ender_dragon: 0.6

entity_minecraft_follow_range.title: Follow Range
entity_minecraft_follow_range.description: Defines the maximum range, in blocks, that a mob will pursue a target. This affects AI behaviors like chasing players or attacking.

value.title: Value
value.description:
The default follow range in blocks. Entities will attempt to stay within this radius of their target.

Sample values:
• allay: 1024
• blaze: 48
• breeze: 32

entity_minecraft_is_collidable.title: Is Collidable
entity_minecraft_is_collidable.description:
Allows other mobs to have vertical and horizontal collisions with this mob. For a collision to occur, both mobs must have a "minecraft:collision_box" component. This component can only be used on mobs and enables collisions exclusively between mobs.
Please note that this type of collision is unreliable for moving collidable mobs. It is recommended to use this component only in scenarios where the collidable mob remains stationary.
Collidable behavior is closely related to stackable behavior. While the "minecraft:is_collidable" component governs how other mobs interact with the component's owner, the "minecraft:is_stackable" component describes how an entity interacts with others of its own kind.

Defines how this entity behaves when leashed to another entity. The first preset which "filter" conditions are met will be applied; if none match, a default configuration is used instead.

• hard_distance (float) = 7
• max_distance (float) = 12

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Conditions that must be met for this preset to be applied.

hard_distance.title: Hard Distance
hard_distance.description: Distance (in blocks) over which the entity starts being pulled towards the leash holder with a spring-like force. Entities can enter and stay in vehicles if the leash is stretched under this distance, but will dismount once it exceeds it.

max_distance.title: Max Distance
max_distance.description: Distance in blocks at which the leash breaks.

rotation_adjustment.title: Rotation Adjustment
rotation_adjustment.description: Adjusts the rotation at which the entity reaches equilibrium, when "spring_type" is set to "dampened" or "quad_dampened".

soft_distance.title: Soft Distance
soft_distance.description: Distance (in blocks) over which the entity starts pathfinding toward the leash holder, if able.

spring_type.title: Spring Type
spring_type.description:
Defines the type of spring-like force that pulls the entity towards its leash holder:
- "bouncy": Simulates a highly elastic spring that never reaches an equilibrium if the leashed entity is suspended mid-air.
- "dampened": Simulates a dampened spring attached to the front of the leashed entity's collision. It reaches an equilibrium if the entity is suspended mid-air and aligns with the movement direction.
- "quad_dampened": Simulates four dampened springs connected to the center of each side of the entities' collisions. It reaches an equilibrium if the entity is suspended mid-air and gradually aligns with the leash holder over time.

entity_minecraft_leashable_to.title: Leashable To
entity_minecraft_leashable_to.description: Allows players to leash entities to this entity, retrieve entities already leashed to it, or free them using shears. For the last interaction to work, the leashed entities must have "can_be_cut" set to true in their "minecraft:leashable" component.

entity_minecraft_looked_at.title: Looked At
entity_minecraft_looked_at.description: Defines the behavior when another entity looks at the owner entity.

anyOf.description: Set to true/false for legacy boolean targeting behavior.

set_target.title: Set Target
set_target.description: Defines if and how the owner entity will set entities that are looking at it as its combat targets. Valid values: 'never', 'once_and_stop_scanning', 'once_and_keep_scanning'.

defaultSnippets.label: Set Target (default)
defaultSnippets.description: Use default value: false

field_of_view.title: Field Of View
field_of_view.description: Defines, in degrees, the width of the field of view for entities looking at the owner entity. If "scale_fov_by_distance" is set to true, this value corresponds to the field of view at a distance of one block between the entities.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Defines which entities are considered when searching for entities looking at the owner entity.

find_players_only.title: Find Players Only
find_players_only.description: Limits the search to only the nearest Player that meets the specified "filters" rather than all nearby entities.

line_of_sight_obstruction_type.title: Line Of Sight Obstruction Type
line_of_sight_obstruction_type.description: Defines the type of block shape used to check for line of sight obstructions. Valid values: "outline", "collision", "collision_for_camera".

look_at_locations.title: Look At Locations
look_at_locations.description: A list of locations on the owner entity towards which line of sight checks are performed. At least one location must be unobstructed for the entity to be considered as looked at.

looked_at_cooldown.title: Looked At Cooldown
looked_at_cooldown.description: Specifies the range for the random number of seconds that must pass before the owner entity can check again for entities looking at it, after detecting an entity looking at it.

looked_at_event.title: Looked At Event
looked_at_event.description: Defines the event to trigger when an entity is detected looking at the owner entity.

min_looked_at_duration.title: Min Looked At Duration
min_looked_at_duration.description: Defines the minimum, continuous time the owner entity has to be looked at before being considered as such. Defaults to 0 if not explicitly specified.

not_looked_at_event.title: Not Looked At Event
not_looked_at_event.description: Defines the event to trigger when no entity is found looking at the owner entity.

scale_fov_by_distance.title: Scale Fov By Distance
scale_fov_by_distance.description: When true, the field of view narrows as the distance between the owner entity and the entity looking at it increases. This ensures that the width of the view cone remains somewhat constant towards the owner entity position, regardless of distance.

search_radius.title: Search Radius
search_radius.description: Maximum distance the owner entity will search for entities looking at it.

entity_minecraft_loot.title: Loot
entity_minecraft_loot.description: Specifies the loot table that determines what items this entity drops upon death. The table path is relative to the behavior pack's root folder.

table.title: Table
table.description: Path to the loot table JSON file, relative to the behavior pack's root (e.g., 'loot_tables/entities/zombie.json').

entity_minecraft_managed_wandering_trade.title: Managed Wandering Trader
entity_minecraft_managed_wandering_trade.description: Manages the entity's ability to trade.

entity_minecraft_mark_variant.title: Mark Variant
entity_minecraft_mark_variant.description: Mark Variant is typically used as an additional per-type way (besides `variant`) to express a different visual form of the same mob.

value.title: Value
value.description: The Id of the mark_variant. By convention, 0 is the Id of the base entity.

entity_minecraft_mob_effect.title: Mob Effect
entity_minecraft_mob_effect.description: A component that applies a mob effect to entities that get within range.

ambient.title: Ambient
ambient.description: If the effect is considered an ambient effect (like the ones applied by Beacons or Conduits).

cooldown_time.title: Cooldown Time
cooldown_time.description: Time in seconds to wait between each application of the effect.

effect_range.title: Effect Range
effect_range.description: How close a hostile entity must be to have the mob effect applied.

effect_time.title: Effect Time
effect_time.description: How long the applied mob effect lasts in seconds. Can also be set to "infinite"

entity_filter.title: Entity Filter
entity_filter.description: The set of entities that are valid to apply the mob effect to.

mob_effect.title: Mob Effect
mob_effect.description: The mob effect that is applied to entities that enter this entities effect range.

entity_minecraft_mob_effect_immunity.title: Mob Effect Immunity
entity_minecraft_mob_effect_immunity.description: Entities with this component will have an immunity to the provided mob effects.

mob_effects.title: Mob Effects
mob_effects.description:
List of names of effects the entity is immune to.

Sample values:
• parched: ["weakness"]
• silverfish: ["infested"]
• slime: ["oozing"]

entity_minecraft_movement.title: Movement
entity_minecraft_movement.description: Defines the base movement speed of an entity. Typical values: creeper (0.2), cow (0.25), zombie baby (0.35).

defaultSnippets.label: Value (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Value as an object

value.title: Value
value.description: The base movement speed value. Higher values result in faster movement. Can be a single number or a range object with range_min and range_max properties.

defaultSnippets.label: Value (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Value as an object

max.title: Max
max.description: Maximum movement speed this entity can have.

entity_minecraft_movement_amphibious.title: Amphibious Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_amphibious.description: This move control allows the mob to swim in water and walk on land.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

entity_minecraft_movement_basic.title: Basic Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_basic.description: This component accents the movement of an entity.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

entity_minecraft_movement_dolphin.title: Dolphin Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_dolphin.description: This component can control how dolphins move, in a dolphin-esque style.

entity_minecraft_movement_fly.title: Fly Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_fly.description: This move control causes the mob to fly.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

start_speed.title: Start Speed
start_speed.description: Initial speed of the mob when it starts gliding.

speed_when_turning.title: Speed when turning
speed_when_turning.description: Speed that the mob adjusts to when it has to turn quickly.

entity_minecraft_movement_generic.title: Generic Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_generic.description: This move control allows a mob to fly, swim, climb, etc.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

entity_minecraft_movement_glide.title: Glide Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_glide.description: This move control causes the mob to glide.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

speed_when_turning.title: Speed when turning
speed_when_turning.description: Speed that the mob adjusts to when it has to turn quickly.

entity_minecraft_movement_hover.title: Hover Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_hover.description: This move control causes the mob to hover.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

entity_minecraft_movement_jump.title: Jump Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_jump.description: Move control that causes the mob to jump as it moves with a specified delay between jumps.

jump_delay.title: Jump Delay
jump_delay.description: Delay in seconds after landing when using the slime move control. Can be a single number, an array [min, max], or an object with range_min and range_max.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

entity_minecraft_movement_skip.title: Skip Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_skip.description: This move control causes the mob to hop as it moves.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

entity_minecraft_movement_sway.title: Sway Movement
entity_minecraft_movement_sway.description: This move control causes the mob to sway side to side giving the impression it is swimming.

max_turn.title: Max Turn
max_turn.description: The maximum number in degrees the mob can turn per tick.

sway_frequency.title: Sway Frequency
sway_frequency.description: Multiplier for the frequency of the sway movement.

entity_minecraft_movement_sound_distance.title: Movement Sound Distance Offset
entity_minecraft_movement_sound_distance.description: Sets the offset used to determine the next step distance for playing a movement sound.

value.title: Value
value.description: The higher the number, the less often the movement sound will be played.

entity_minecraft_nameable.title: Nameable
entity_minecraft_nameable.description: Allows this entity to be named (e.g. using a name tag).

allow_name_tag_renaming.title: Allow Name Tag Renaming
allow_name_tag_renaming.description: If true, this entity can be renamed with name tags

always_show.title: Always Show
always_show.description: If true, the name will always be shown

default_trigger.title: Default Trigger
default_trigger.description: Trigger to run when the entity gets named

name_actions.title: Name Actions
name_actions.description:
Describes the special names for this entity and the events to call when the entity acquires those names

Properties:
• name_filter (string)
• on_named

name_filter.title: Name Filter
name_filter.description: List of special names that will cause the events defined in 'on_named' to fire

on_named.title: Named
on_named.description: Event to be called when this entity acquires the name specified in 'name_filter'

blocks.description: Array of block identifiers that share this cost value.

Cost for non-preferred blocks

entity_minecraft_projectile.title: Projectile
entity_minecraft_projectile.description: Allows the entity to be a thrown entity.

angle_offset.title: Angle Offset
angle_offset.description: Determines the angle at which the projectile is thrown

catch_fire.title: Catch Fire
catch_fire.description: If true, the entity hit will be set on fire

crit_particle_on_hurt.title: Crit Particle On Hurt
crit_particle_on_hurt.description: If true, the projectile will produce additional particles when a critical hit happens

destroy_on_hurt.title: Destroy On Hurt
destroy_on_hurt.description: If true, this entity will be destroyed when hit

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Entity Definitions defined here can't be hurt by the projectile

fire_affected_by_griefing.title: Fire Affected By Griefing
fire_affected_by_griefing.description: If true, whether the projectile causes fire is affected by the mob griefing game rule

gravity.title: Gravity
gravity.description: The gravity applied to this entity when thrown. The higher the value, the faster the entity falls

hit_nearest_passenger.title: Hit Nearest Passenger
hit_nearest_passenger.description: If true, when hitting a vehicle, and there's at least one passenger in the vehicle, the damage will be dealt to the passenger closest to the projectile impact point. If there are no passengers, this setting does nothing.

hit_sound.title: Hit Sound
hit_sound.description: The sound that plays when the projectile hits something

homing.title: Homing
homing.description: If true, the projectile homes in to the nearest entity

ignored_entities.title: Ignored Entities
ignored_entities.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] An array of strings defining the types of entities that this entity does not collide with.

inertia.title: Inertia
inertia.description: The fraction of the projectile's speed maintained every frame while traveling in air

is_dangerous.title: Is Dangerous
is_dangerous.description: If true, the projectile will be treated as dangerous to the players

knockback.title: Knockback
knockback.description: If true, the projectile will knock back the entity it hits

lightning.title: Lightning
lightning.description: If true, the entity hit will be struck by lightning

liquid_inertia.title: Liquid Inertia
liquid_inertia.description: The fraction of the projectile's speed maintained every frame while traveling in water

multiple_targets.title: Multiple Targets
multiple_targets.description: If true, the projectile can hit multiple entities per flight

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: The offset from the entity's anchor where the projectile will spawn

on_fire_time.title: Fire Time
on_fire_time.description: Time in seconds that the entity hit will be on fire for

potion_effect.title: Potion Effect
potion_effect.description: Defines the effect the arrow will apply to the entity it hits

power.title: Power
power.description: Determines the velocity of the projectile

reflect_immunity.title: Reflect Immunity
reflect_immunity.description: During the specified time, in seconds, the projectile cannot be reflected by hitting it

reflect_on_hurt.title: Reflect On Hurt
reflect_on_hurt.description: If true, this entity will be reflected back when hit

semi_random_diff_damage.title: Semi Random Diff Damage
semi_random_diff_damage.description: If true, damage will be randomized based on damage and speed

shoot_sound.title: Shoot Sound
shoot_sound.description: The sound that plays when the projectile is shot

shoot_target.title: Shoot Target
shoot_target.description: If true, the projectile will be shot towards the target of the entity firing it

should_bounce.title: Should Bounce
should_bounce.description: If true, the projectile will bounce upon hit

splash_potion.title: Splash Potion
splash_potion.description: If true, the projectile will be treated like a splash potion

splash_range.title: Splash Range
splash_range.description: Radius in blocks of the 'splash' effect

uncertainty_base.title: Uncertainty Base
uncertainty_base.description: The base accuracy. Accuracy is determined by the formula uncertaintyBase - difficultyLevel * uncertaintyMultiplier

uncertainty_multiplier.title: Uncertainty Multiplier
uncertainty_multiplier.description: Determines how much difficulty affects accuracy. Accuracy is determined by the formula uncertaintyBase - difficultyLevel * uncertaintyMultiplier

entity_minecraft_push_through.title: Push Through
entity_minecraft_push_through.description: Sets the distance through which the entity can push through.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value of the entity's push-through, in blocks.

entity_minecraft_pushable.title: Pushable
entity_minecraft_pushable.description: Defines what can push an entity between other entities and pistons.

is_pushable.title: Is Pushable
is_pushable.description:
Whether the entity can be pushed by other entities.

Sample values:
• allay: true

is_pushable_by_piston.title: Is Pushable By Piston
is_pushable_by_piston.description:
Whether the entity can be pushed by pistons safely.

Sample values:
• allay: true

entity_minecraft_raid_trigger.title: Raid Trigger
entity_minecraft_raid_trigger.description: Attempts to trigger a raid at the entity's location.

triggered_event.title: Triggered Event
triggered_event.description: Event to run when a raid is triggered on the village.
