entity_minecraft_rail_movement.description: Defines the entity's movement on the rails. An entity with this component is only allowed to move on the rail.

max_speed.title: Max Speed
max_speed.description: Maximum speed that this entity will move at when on the rail.

entity_minecraft_rail_sensor.title: Rail Sensor
entity_minecraft_rail_sensor.description: Enables minecart-type entities to detect powered rails and respond to activation state changes. Triggers events when the entity passes over activated or deactivated rails, enabling custom minecart behaviors like launching at boosted speed, stopping at braking rails, or triggering special effects at detector rails.

check_block_types.title: Check Block Types
check_block_types.description:
If true, on tick this entity will trigger its on_deactivate behavior

Sample values:
• command_block_minecart: true

eject_on_activate.title: Eject On Activate
eject_on_activate.description:
If true, this entity will eject all of its riders when it passes over an activated rail

Sample values:
• minecart: true

eject_on_deactivate.title: Eject On Deactivate
eject_on_deactivate.description: If true, this entity will eject all of its riders when it passes over a deactivated rail

on_activate.title: Activate

on_deactivate.title: Deactivate

tick_command_block_on_activate.title: Tick Command Block On Activate
tick_command_block_on_activate.description:
If true, command blocks will start ticking when passing over an activated rail

Sample values:
• command_block_minecart: true

tick_command_block_on_deactivate.title: Tick Command Block On Deactivate
tick_command_block_on_deactivate.description: If false, command blocks will stop ticking when passing over a deactivated rail

entity_minecraft_ravager_blocked.title: Ravager Blocked
entity_minecraft_ravager_blocked.description: Defines the ravager's response to their melee attack being blocked.

knockback_strength.title: Knockback Strength
knockback_strength.description: The strength with which blocking entities should be knocked back

reaction_choices.title: Reaction Choices
reaction_choices.description: A list of weighted responses to the melee attack being blocked

entity_minecraft_reflect_projectiles.title: Reflect Projectiles
entity_minecraft_reflect_projectiles.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Allows an entity to reflect projectiles.

azimuth_angle.title: Azimuth Angle
azimuth_angle.description:
[EXPERIMENTAL] A Molang expression defining the angle in degrees to add to the projectile's y axis rotation.

Sample values:
• breeze: 180.0 + Math.random(-20.0, 20.0)

elevation_angle.title: Elevation Angle
elevation_angle.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] A Molang expression defining the angle in degrees to add to the projectile's x axis rotation.

reflected_projectiles.title: Reflected Projectiles
reflected_projectiles.description:
[EXPERIMENTAL] An array of strings defining the types of projectiles that are reflected when they hit the entity.

Sample values:
• breeze: ["xp_bottle","thrown_trident","shulker_bullet",...

reflection_scale.title: Reflection Scale
reflection_scale.description:
[EXPERIMENTAL] A Molang expression defining the velocity scaling of the reflected projectile. Values below 1 decrease the projectile's velocity, and values above 1 increase it.

Sample values:
• breeze: 0.5

reflection_sound.title: Reflection Sound
reflection_sound.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] A string defining the name of the sound event to be played when a projectile is reflected. "reflect" unless specified.

entity_minecraft_renders_when_invisible.title: Renders When Invisible
entity_minecraft_renders_when_invisible.description: When set, the entity will render even when invisible. Appropriate rendering behavior can then be specified in the corresponding "minecraft:client_entity".

seat_count.title: Number of seats
seat_count.description:
The number of entities that can ride this entity at the same time.

Sample values:
• chicken: 1
• hoglin: 3

crouching_skip_interact.title: This entity can't be interacted with while crouching.
crouching_skip_interact.description:
If true, this entity can't be interacted with if the entity interacting with it is crouching.

Sample values:
• llama: true

controlling_seat.title: The seat that controls how this entity moves
controlling_seat.description: The seat that designates the driver of the entity. Entities with the "minecraft:behavior.controlled_by_player" goal ignore this field and give control to any player in any seat.

pulls_in_entities.title: This entity will pull in nearby entities.

rider_can_interact.title: Whether a rider can interact with this item.
rider_can_interact.description: If true, this entity will be picked when looked at by the rider.

on_rider_enter_event.title: Rider Enter Event
on_rider_enter_event.description:
Event to execute on the owner entity when an entity starts riding it.

*Introduced in version 1.21.80*

on_rider_exit_event.title: Rider Exit Event
on_rider_exit_event.description:
Event to execute on the owner entity when an entity stops riding it.

*Introduced in version 1.21.80*

dismount_mode.title: Dismount Mode
dismount_mode.description:
Defines where riders are placed when dismounting this entity:
- "default", riders are placed on a valid ground position around the entity, or at the center of the entity's collision box if none is found.
- "on_top_center", riders are placed at the center of the top of the entity's collision box.

rotate_rider_by.title: Rotate Rider By
rotate_rider_by.description: Offset to rotate riders by. Can be a number or a Molang expression.

lock_rider_rotation.title: Lock Rider Rotation
lock_rider_rotation.description: Angle in degrees to rotate the rider by. Can be a number or a Molang expression.

seats.title: Seats

family_types.title: Family Types
family_types.description:
List of entities that can ride this entity.

Sample values:
• chicken: ["baby_undead"]
• hoglin: ["piglin"]
• llama: ["player"]

interact_text.title: Interact Text
interact_text.description:
The text to display when the player can interact with the entity when playing with touch-screen controls.

Sample values:
• llama: action.interact.mount
• llama: action.interact.ride.horse
• minecart: action.interact.ride.minecart

passenger_max_width.title: Passenger Max Width
passenger_max_width.description: The max width a mob can have to be a rider. A value of 0 ignores this parameter.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: This field may exist in old data but isn't used by "minecraft:rideable".

pull_in_entities.title: Pull In Entities
pull_in_entities.description:
If true, this entity will pull entities matching the specified "family_types" into any available seats. Entities that are leashed will only be pulled in if their distance to their leash holder is less than the "hard_distance" defined in their own "minecraft:leashable" component.

Sample values:
• minecart: true

entity_minecraft_rotation_axis_aligned.title: Rotation Axis Aligned
entity_minecraft_rotation_axis_aligned.description:
Causes the entity to automatically rotate to align with the nearest cardinal direction based on its current facing direction.
Combining this with the "minecraft:body_rotation_blocked" component will cause the entity's body to align with the nearest cardinal direction and remain fixed in that orientation, regardless of changes in its facing direction.

entity_minecraft_scale.title: Scale
entity_minecraft_scale.description: Sets the entity's visual size multiplier. A value of 1.0 means normal size, 0.5 is half size (commonly used for baby mobs), and values above 1.0 make the entity larger.

value.title: Value
value.description: The scale multiplier for visual size. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = half (babies), 2.0 = double size.

entity_minecraft_scale_by_age.title: Scale By Age
entity_minecraft_scale_by_age.description: Defines the entity's size interpolation based on the entity's age.

end_scale.title: End Scale
end_scale.description: Ending scale of the entity when it's fully grown.

start_scale.title: Start Scale
start_scale.description: Initial scale of the newborn entity.

entity_minecraft_scheduler.title: Scheduler
entity_minecraft_scheduler.description: Fires off scheduled mob events at time of day events.

min_delay_secs.title: The minimum the scheduler will be delayed.

max_delay_secs.title: The maximum the scheduler will be delayed.

scheduled_events.title: Scheduled Events
scheduled_events.description:
The list of triggers that fire when the conditions match the given filter criteria. Can be an array of event objects or a single event object.

Sample values:
• fox: [{"filters":[{"test":"is_sleeping","value":true...

entity_minecraft_shareables.title: Shareables
entity_minecraft_shareables.description: Defines a list of items the mob wants to share or pick up. Items can be configured with optional parameters to control pickup, sharing, and inventory behavior.

all_items.title: All Items
all_items.description:
A bucket for all other items in the game. Note this category is always least priority items.

Sample values:
• fox: true

all_items_max_amount.title: All Items Max Amount
all_items_max_amount.description:
Maximum number of this item the mob will hold.

Sample values:
• fox: 1

all_items_surplus_amount.title: All Items Surplus Amount
all_items_surplus_amount.description: Number of this item considered extra that the entity wants to share.

all_items_want_amount.title: All Items Want Amount
all_items_want_amount.description: Number of this item this entity wants to share.

items.title: Items
items.description:
List of items or item tags that the entity wants to share. Items in-game will match to this list from top to bottom, meaning that the first occurance of a match, be it name or tag, will shadow those coming after.

Properties:
• admire (boolean) = false
• barter (boolean) = false
• consume_item (boolean) = false
• craft_into (string)
• item (string)
• max_amount (int) = -1
• pickup_limit (int) = -1
• pickup_only (boolean) = false
• ... and 4 more properties

Sample values:
• bogged: [{"item":"minecraft:netherite_sword","priority"...
• drowned: [{"item":"minecraft:trident","priority":0,"surp...

admire.title: Admire
admire.description: Mob will admire the item after picking up by looking at it. For this to happen the mob needs to have an Admire component and an Admire goal.

barter.title: Barter
barter.description: Mob will barter for the item after picking it up. For this to work the mob needs to have a Barter component and a Barter goal.

consume_item.title: Consume Item
consume_item.description: Determines whether the mob will consume the item or not.

craft_into.title: Craft Into
craft_into.description: Defines the item this entity wants to craft with the item defined by "item". Should be an item name.

item.title: Item
item.description: The name of the item. Aux value can be specified, for instance 'minecraft:skull:1'. Alternatively, a tag can be specified to match all items with that tag.

max_amount.title: Max Amount
max_amount.description: Maximum number of this item the mob will hold.

pickup_limit.title: Pickup Limit
pickup_limit.description: Maximum number items the mob will pick up during a single goal tick.

pickup_only.title: Pickup Only
pickup_only.description: Determines whether the mob can only pickup the item and not drop it.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Prioritizes which items the entity prefers. 0 is the highest priority.

stored_in_inventory.title: Stored In Inventory
stored_in_inventory.description: Determines whether the mob will try to put the item in its inventory if it has the inventory component and if it can't be equipped.

surplus_amount.title: Surplus Amount
surplus_amount.description: Number of this item considered extra that the entity wants to share.

want_amount.title: Want Amount
want_amount.description: Number of this item this entity wants to share.

singular_pickup.title: Singular Pickup
singular_pickup.description: Boolean value that controls if the mob is able to pick up more of the same item if it is already holding that item

entity_minecraft_shooter.title: Shooter
entity_minecraft_shooter.description: Defines the entity's ranged attack behavior. The "minecraft:behavior.ranged_attack" goal uses this component to determine which projectiles to shoot.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description:
Sound that is played when the shooter shoots a projectile.

Sample values:
• bogged: bow
• drowned: item.trident.throw

aux_val.title: Aux Val
aux_val.description:
ID of the Potion effect for the default projectile to be applied on hit.

Sample values:
• bogged: 26

def.title: Def
def.description:
Actor definition to use as the default projectile for the ranged attack. The actor definition must have the projectile component to be able to be shot as a projectile.

Sample values:
• blaze: minecraft:small_fireball
• bogged: minecraft:arrow
• drowned: minecraft:thrown_trident

magic.title: Magic
magic.description: Sets whether the projectiles being used are flagged as magic. If set, the ranged attack goal will not be used at the same time as other magic goals, such as minecraft:behavior.drink_potion

power.title: Power
power.description: Velocity in which the projectiles will be shot at. A power of 0 will be overwritten by the default projectile throw power.

projectiles.title: Projectiles
projectiles.description: List of projectiles that can be used by the shooter. Projectiles are evaluated in the order of the list; After a projectile is chosen, the rest of the list is ignored.

sit_event.title: Sit Event
sit_event.description: Event to run when the entity enters the 'sit' state. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

stand_event.title: Stand Event
stand_event.description: Event to run when the entity exits the 'sit' state. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

entity_minecraft_skin_id.title: Skin Id
entity_minecraft_skin_id.description: Skin ID value. Can be used to differentiate skins, such as base skins for villagers.

value.title: Value
value.description: The ID of the skin. By convention, 0 is the ID of the base skin.

entity_minecraft_sound_volume.title: Sound Volume
entity_minecraft_sound_volume.description: Sets the entity's base volume for sound effects.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value of the volume the entity uses for sound effects.

entity_minecraft_spawn_entity.title: Spawn Entity
entity_minecraft_spawn_entity.description: Adds a timer after which this entity will spawn another entity or item (similar to vanilla's chicken's egg-laying behavior).

filters.title: Filters
filters.description:
Sample values:
• chicken: [{"test":"rider_count","subject":"self","operat...

entities.title: Entities
entities.description:
List of entity spawn definitions. Can be a single object or an array of objects.

Properties:
• min_wait_time (number)
• max_wait_time (number)
• spawn_sound (string)
• spawn_item (string)
• filters (string)

Sample values:
• chicken: [{"min_wait_time":300,"max_wait_time":600,"spaw...
• drowned: {"max_wait_time":0,"min_wait_time":0,"num_to_sp...
• sniffer: {"min_wait_time":0,"max_wait_time":0,"spawn_sou...

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: If present, the specified entity will only spawn if the filter evaluates to true.

max_wait_time.title: Max Wait Time
max_wait_time.description: Maximum amount of time to randomly wait in seconds before another entity is spawned.

min_wait_time.title: Min Wait Time
min_wait_time.description: Minimum amount of time to randomly wait in seconds before another entity is spawned.

num_to_spawn.title: Num To Spawn
num_to_spawn.description: The number of entities of this type to spawn each time that this triggers.

should_leash.title: Should Leash
should_leash.description: If true, this the spawned entity will be leashed to the parent.

single_use.title: Single Use
single_use.description: If true, this component will only ever spawn the specified entity once.

spawn_entity.title: Spawn Entity
spawn_entity.description: Identifier of the entity to spawn, leave empty to spawn the item defined by "spawn_item" instead.

spawn_event.title: Spawn Event
spawn_event.description: Event to call on the spawned entity when it spawns.

spawn_item.title: Spawn Item
spawn_item.description: Item identifier of the item to spawn.

spawn_item_event.title: Spawn Item Event
spawn_item_event.description: Event to call on this entity when the item is spawned.

spawn_method.title: Spawn Method
spawn_method.description: Method to use to spawn the entity.

spawn_sound.title: Spawn Sound
spawn_sound.description: Identifier of the sound effect to play when the entity is spawned.

entity_minecraft_spell_effects.title: Spell Effects
entity_minecraft_spell_effects.description: Allows an entity to add or remove status effects from itself. Similarly to `addrider`, this component performs a one-time operation on the entity when added. Removing the component will not change the entity's current effects. Adding different versions of the component multiple times will perform each one in turn. Once the component has been added, it will not provide any further functionality. There is one exception to this behavior: if this component is present on a player, its effects will be re-applied every time the player enters the world. To avoid this, remove the component shortly after adding it, or add an empty component to replace it.

add_effects.title: Add Effects
add_effects.description:
List of effects to add to this entity after adding this component

Properties:
• effect (string)
• display_on_screen_animation (string)
• duration (number)

Sample values:
• player: [{"display_on_screen_animation":true,"duration"...

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect to add to this entity. Includes 'duration' in seconds, 'amplifier' level, 'ambient' if it is to be considered an ambient effect, and 'visible' if the effect should be visible

remove_effects.title: Remove Effects
remove_effects.description:
List of identifiers of effects to be removed from this entity after adding this component

Sample values:
• player: bad_omen

entity_minecraft_strength.title: Strength
entity_minecraft_strength.description: Defines the entity's strength to carry items.

max.title: Max
max.description: The maximum strength of this entity

value.title: Value
value.description: The initial value of the strength

entity_minecraft_suspect_tracking.title: Suspect Tracking
entity_minecraft_suspect_tracking.description: Allows this entity to remember suspicious locations

probability.title: Probability of being tamed
probability.description:
The chance of taming the entity with each item use between 0.0 and 1.0, where 1.0 is 100%

Sample values:
• parrot: 0.33

tameItems.title: List of items that can be fed to an entity to tame them

tame_event.title: Event to fire when the entity is tamed

tame_items.title: Tame Items
tame_items.description:
The list of items that can be used to tame this entity

Sample values:
• parrot: ["wheat_seeds","pumpkin_seeds","melon_seeds","b...

entity_minecraft_tamemount.title: Tamemount
entity_minecraft_tamemount.description: Allows the Entity to be tamed by mounting it.

attempt_temper_mod.title: Attempt Temper Mod
attempt_temper_mod.description: The amount the entity's temper will increase when mounted.

autoRejectItems.title: AutoRejectItems
autoRejectItems.description:
The list of items that, if carried while interacting with the entity, will anger it.

Properties:
• item (string)

item.title: Item
item.description: Name of the item this entity dislikes and will cause it to get angry if used while untamed.

feed_items.title: Feed Items
feed_items.description:
The list of items that can be used to increase the entity's temper and speed up the taming process.

Properties:
• item (string)
• temper_mod (int) = 0

Sample values:
• llama: [{"item":"wheat","temper_mod":3},{"item":"hay_b...

item.title: Item
item.description: Name of the item this entity likes and can be used to increase this entity's temper.

temper_mod.title: Temper Mod
temper_mod.description: The amount of temper this entity gains when fed this item.

feed_text.title: Feed Text
feed_text.description:
The text that shows in the feeding interact button.

Sample values:
• llama: action.interact.feed

max_temper.title: Max Temper
max_temper.description:
The maximum value for the entity's random starting temper.

Sample values:
• llama: 30

min_temper.title: Min Temper
min_temper.description: The minimum value for the entity's random starting temper.

ride_text.title: Ride Text
ride_text.description:
The text that shows in the riding interact button.

Sample values:
• llama: action.interact.mount

tame_event.title: Tame Event

entity_minecraft_target_nearby_sensor.title: Target Nearby Sensor
entity_minecraft_target_nearby_sensor.description: Defines the entity's range within which it can see or sense other entities to target them.

on_inside_range.title: On Inside Range
on_inside_range.description:
Event to call when an entity gets in the inside range. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

Sample values:
• blaze: {"event":"switch_to_melee","target":"self"}
• drowned: {"event":"minecraft:switch_to_melee","target":"...

on_outside_range.title: On Outside Range
on_outside_range.description:
Event to call when an entity gets outside the outside range. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

Sample values:
• blaze: {"event":"switch_to_ranged","target":"self"}
• drowned: {"event":"minecraft:switch_to_ranged","target":...

inside_range.title: Inside Range
inside_range.description:
Maximum distance in blocks that another entity will be considered in the 'inside' range

Sample values:
• blaze: 2
• drowned: 3

must_see.title: Must See
must_see.description:
Whether the other entity needs to be visible to trigger 'inside' events

Sample values:
• blaze: true

on_vision_lost_inside_range.title: Vision Lost Inside Range
on_vision_lost_inside_range.description: Event to call when an entity exits visual range. Can specify 'event' for the name of the event and 'target' for the target of the event

outside_range.title: Outside Range
outside_range.description:
Maximum distance in blocks that another entity will be considered in the 'outside' range

Sample values:
• blaze: 3
• drowned: 5

dark_teleport_chance.title: Dark Teleport Chance
dark_teleport_chance.description: Modifies the chance that the entity will teleport if the entity is in darkness

light_teleport_chance.title: Light Teleport Chance
light_teleport_chance.description: Modifies the chance that the entity will teleport if the entity is in daylight

max_random_teleport_time.title: Max Random Teleport Time
max_random_teleport_time.description: Maximum amount of time in seconds between random teleports

min_random_teleport_time.title: Min Random Teleport Time
min_random_teleport_time.description: Minimum amount of time in seconds between random teleports

random_teleport_cube.title: Random Teleport Cube
random_teleport_cube.description: Entity will teleport to a random position within the area defined by this cube

random_teleports.title: Random Teleports
random_teleports.description: If true, the entity will teleport randomly

target_distance.title: Target Distance
target_distance.description: Maximum distance the entity will teleport when chasing a target

target_teleport_chance.title: Target Teleport Chance
target_teleport_chance.description: The chance that the entity will teleport between 0.0 and 1.0. 1.0 means 100%

entity_minecraft_tick_world.title: Entity Tick World
entity_minecraft_tick_world.description: Defines if the entity ticks the world and the radius around it to tick.

distance_to_players.title: Distance To Players
distance_to_players.description: The distance at which the closest player has to be before this entity despawns. This option will be ignored if never_despawn is true.

never_despawn.title: Never Despawn
never_despawn.description: If true, this entity will not despawn even if players are far away. If false, distance_to_players will be used to determine when to despawn.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: The area around the entity to tick.

entity_minecraft_timer.title: Timer
entity_minecraft_timer.description: Adds a timer after which an event will fire.

time.title: Time
time.description: Amount of time in seconds for the timer. Can be specified as a number or a pair of numbers (min and max). Incompatible with random_time_choices.

time_down_event.title: Time Down Event
time_down_event.description: Event to fire when the time on the timer runs out. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

looping.title: Looping
looping.description: If true, the timer will restart every time after it fires.

randomInterval.title: RandomInterval
randomInterval.description: If true, the amount of time on the timer will be random between the min and max values specified in time.

random_time_choices.title: Random Time Choices
random_time_choices.description: This is a list of objects, representing one value in seconds that can be picked before firing the event and an optional weight. Incompatible with time.

entity_minecraft_trade_table.title: Trade Table
entity_minecraft_trade_table.description: Defines this entity's ability to trade with players.

convert_trades_economy.title: Convert Trades Economy
convert_trades_economy.description: Determines when the mob transforms, if the trades should be converted when the new mob has a economy_trade_table. When the trades are converted, the mob will generate a new trade list with their new trade table, but then it will try to convert any of the same trades over to have the same enchantments and user data. For example, if the original has a Emerald to Enchanted Iron Sword (Sharpness 1), and the new trade also has an Emerald for Enchanted Iron Sword, then the enchantment will be Sharpness 1.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Name to be displayed while trading with this entity.

new_screen.title: New Screen
new_screen.description: Used to determine if trading with entity opens the new trade screen.

persist_trades.title: Persist Trades
persist_trades.description: Determines if the trades should persist when the mob transforms. This makes it so that the next time the mob is transformed to something with a trade_table or economy_trade_table, then it keeps their trades.

table.title: Table
table.description: File path relative to the behavior pack root for this entity's trades.

entity_minecraft_trail.title: Trail
entity_minecraft_trail.description: Causes an entity to leave a trail of blocks as it moves about the world.

block_type.title: Block Type
block_type.description: The type of block you wish to be spawned by the entity as it move about the world. Solid blocks may not be spawned at an offset of (0,0,0).

spawn_filter.title: Spawn Filter
spawn_filter.description: One or more conditions that must be met in order to cause the chosen block type to spawn.

spawn_offset.title: Spawn Offset
spawn_offset.description: The distance from the entities current position to spawn the block. Capped at up to 16 blocks away. The X value is left/right(-/+), the Z value is backward/forward(-/+), the Y value is below/above(-/+).

entity_minecraft_transformation.title: Transformation
entity_minecraft_transformation.description: Defines an entity's transformation from the current definition into another

add.title: Add
add.description:
List of components to add to the entity after the transformation

Properties:
• component_groups (string[])

component_groups.title: Component Groups
component_groups.description: Names of component groups to add

begin_transform_sound.title: Begin Transform Sound
begin_transform_sound.description: Sound to play when the transformation starts

delay.title: Delay
delay.description:
Defines the properties of the delay for the transformation

Properties:
• block_assist_chance (float) = 0
• block_chance (float) = 0
• block_max (int) = 0
• block_radius (int) = 0
• block_types (string[])
• range_max (float) = 0
• range_min (float) = 0
• value (float) = 0

Sample values:
• pig: 0.5

block_assist_chance.title: Block Assist Chance
block_assist_chance.description: Chance that the entity will look for nearby blocks that can speed up the transformation. Value must be between 0.0 and 1.0

block_chance.title: Block Chance
block_chance.description: Chance that, once a block is found, will help speed up the transformation

block_max.title: Block Max
block_max.description: Maximum number of blocks the entity will look for to aid in the transformation. If not defined or set to 0, it will be set to the block radius

block_radius.title: Block Radius
block_radius.description: Distance in Blocks that the entity will search for blocks that can help the transformation

block_types.title: Block Types
block_types.description: List of blocks that can help the transformation of this entity

range_max.title: Range Max
range_max.description: Time in seconds to be added to value to have the maximum random time range value until the entity transforms (if non-zero then the time in seconds before the entity transforms will be random between value+range_min and value+range_max)

range_min.title: Range Min
range_min.description: Time in seconds to be added to value to have the minimum random time range value until the entity transforms (if non-zero then the time in seconds before the entity transforms will be random between value+range_min and value+range_max)

value.title: Value
value.description: Time in seconds before the entity transforms

drop_equipment.title: Drop Equipment
drop_equipment.description: Cause the entity to drop all equipment upon transformation

drop_inventory.title: Drop Inventory
drop_inventory.description:
Cause the entity to drop all items in inventory upon transformation

Sample values:
• skeleton: true

into.title: Into
into.description:
Entity Definition that this entity will transform into

Sample values:
• hoglin: minecraft:zoglin
• pig: minecraft:pig_zombie
• skeleton: minecraft:stray

keep_level.title: Keep Level
keep_level.description:
If this entity has trades and has leveled up, it should maintain that level after transformation.

Sample values:
• hoglin: true

keep_owner.title: Keep Owner
keep_owner.description: If this entity is owned by another entity, it should remain owned after transformation.

preserve_equipment.title: Preserve Equipment
preserve_equipment.description:
Cause the entity to keep equipment after going through transformation

Sample values:
• skeleton: true

transformation_sound.title: Transformation Sound
transformation_sound.description:
Sound to play when the entity is done transforming

Sample values:
• hoglin: mob.hoglin.converted_to_zombified
• pig: mob.pig.death
• skeleton: convert_to_stray

entity_minecraft_transient.title: Transient
entity_minecraft_transient.description: An entity with this component will NEVER persist, and forever disappear when unloaded.

entity_minecraft_trust.title: Trust
entity_minecraft_trust.description: Allows this entity to trust multiple players.

entity_minecraft_trusting.title: Trusting
entity_minecraft_trusting.description: Defines the rules for a mob to trust players.

trust_event.title: Trust Event
trust_event.description: Event to run when this entity becomes trusting. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

trust_items.title: Trust Items
trust_items.description: The list of items that can be used to get the entity to trust players. Can be an array or a single item string.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: The chance of the entity trusting with each item use between 0.0 and 1.0, where 1.0 is 100%.

entity_minecraft_type_family.title: Type Family
entity_minecraft_type_family.description: Defines the family categories this entity belongs to. Type families are used by filters and other game systems to group entities (e.g., 'mob', 'monster', 'undead', 'zombie').

family.title: Type Family (Tag)
family.description:
A set of tags that describe the categories of this entity. In addition to typically having a tag for the type of mob, entities frequently have additional type family tags that modify how the rest of the Minecraft world reacts to them.

Sample values:
• allay: ["allay","mob"]
• armor_stand: ["armor_stand","inanimate","mob"]
• bat: ["bat","mob"]

entity_minecraft_underwater_movement.title: Underwater Movement
entity_minecraft_underwater_movement.description: Defines the speed with which an entity can move through water.

value.title: Value
value.description:
Movement speed of the entity under water.

Sample values:
• dolphin: 0.15
• elder_guardian: 0.3
• guardian: 0.12

entity_minecraft_variable_max_auto_step.title: Variable Max Auto Step
entity_minecraft_variable_max_auto_step.description: Entities with this component will have a maximum auto step height that is different depending on whether they are on a block that prevents jumping. Incompatible with "runtime_identifier": "minecraft:horse".

base_value.title: Base Value
base_value.description: The maximum auto step height when on any other block.

controlled_value.title: Controlled Value
controlled_value.description: The maximum auto step height when on any other block and controlled by the player.

jump_prevented_value.title: Jump Prevented Value
jump_prevented_value.description: The maximum auto step height when on a block that prevents jumping.

entity_minecraft_variant.title: Variant
entity_minecraft_variant.description: Variant is typically used as a per-type way to express a different visual form of the same mob. For example, for cats, variant is a number that defines the breed of cat.

value.title: Value
value.description: The Id of the variant. By convention, 0 is the Id of the base entity/default appearance.

entity_minecraft_vibration_damper.title: Vibration Damper
entity_minecraft_vibration_damper.description: Vibrations emitted by this entity will be ignored.

entity_minecraft_vibration_listener.title: Vibration Listener
entity_minecraft_vibration_listener.description: Allows the entity to listen to vibration events. This is a largely-internal component, that is only supported on the Warden and Allay mobs.

entity_minecraft_walk_animation_speed.title: Walk Animation Speed
entity_minecraft_walk_animation_speed.description: Sets the speed multiplier for this entity's walk animation speed.

value.title: Value
value.description: The higher the number, the faster the animation for walking plays. A value of 1.0 means normal speed, while 2.0 means twice as fast.

entity_minecraft_wants_jockey.title: Wants Jockey
entity_minecraft_wants_jockey.description: Sets that this entity wants to become a jockey.

entity_minecraft_water_movement.title: Water Movement
entity_minecraft_water_movement.description: Customizes how the entity moves through water by adjusting drag coefficient. Lower values let entities glide through water easily like fish, while higher values create resistance for entities that struggle in water. Essential for aquatic mobs, boats, and any entity needing custom underwater physics.

drag_factor.title: Drag Factor
drag_factor.description:
Drag factor to determine movement speed when in water.

Sample values:
• polar_bear: 0.98

entity_aquatic_charge_attack.title: Entity Aquatic Charge Attack Behavior
entity_aquatic_charge_attack.description: Enables an aquatic mob to dash at its target with knockback; includes overshoot and cooldown settings.

attack_reach.title: Attack Reach
attack_reach.description: Horizontal reach grown around the mob's AABB to register a hit.

charge_cooldown_time.title: Charge Cooldown Time
charge_cooldown_time.description:
Range of time in seconds to wait before starting another charge.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components FloatRange
defaultSnippets.description: Has minimum and maximum float values.

charge_cooldown_time.x-runtime-constraint-description: Check that the limits imposed on the range (minimum, maximum and maximum distance between values) are respected

charge_overshoot_distance.title: Charge Overshoot Distance
charge_overshoot_distance.description: Distance beyond the target the mob aims during a charge.

charge_speed.title: Charge Speed
charge_speed.description: Absolute speed used during the charge attack.

knockback_force.title: Knockback Force
knockback_force.description: Knockback force applied to the target on hit.

max_charge_distance.title: Max Charge Distance
max_charge_distance.description: Maximum distance at which the mob attempts a charge.

entity_avoid_block.title: Entity Avoid Block Behavior
entity_avoid_block.description: Allows this entity to avoid certain blocks.

on_escape.title: On Escape
on_escape.description:
Event triggers that fire when the entity escapes from the avoided block. Can be a single trigger or an array of triggers.

Properties:
• event (string) = 
• filters ({ domain, operator, subject, ... }) = {"AND":null,"NOT":nu
• target (string) = self

target_blocks.title: Target Blocks
target_blocks.description: List of block types this mob avoids. Can be a single block identifier string or an array of block identifiers.

defaultSnippets.label: Sound Interval (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Sound Interval as an object

sound_interval.title: Sound Interval
sound_interval.description:
Range of time in seconds to randomly wait before playing the sound again. Can be a number, an array, or an object with range_min/range_max or min/max.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

defaultSnippets.label: Sound Interval (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Sound Interval as an object

avoid_block_sound.title: LevelSoundEvent
avoid_block_sound.description: The sound event to play when the mob is avoiding a block.

search_height.title: Search Height
search_height.description: Maximum distance to look for a block in y.

search_range.title: Search Range
search_range.description: Maximum distance to look for a block in xz.

sprint_speed_modifier.title: Sprint Speed Modifier
sprint_speed_modifier.description: Modifier for sprint speed. 1.0 means keep the regular speed, while higher numbers make the sprint speed faster.

walk_speed_modifier.title: Walk Speed Modifier
walk_speed_modifier.description: Modifier for walking speed. 1.0 means keep the regular speed, while higher numbers make the walking speed faster.

entity_avoid_mob_type.title: Entity Avoid Mob Type Behavior
entity_avoid_mob_type.description: Allows the entity to run away from other entities that meet the criteria specified.

entity_types.title: Entity Types
entity_types.description: The list of conditions another entity must meet to be a valid target to avoid.

avoid_mob_sound.title: LevelSoundEvent
avoid_mob_sound.description: The sound event to play when the mob is avoiding another mob.

avoid_target_xz.title: Avoid Target Xz
avoid_target_xz.description: The next target position the entity chooses to avoid another entity will be chosen within this XZ Distance.

avoid_target_y.title: Avoid Target Y
avoid_target_y.description: The next target position the entity chooses to avoid another entity will be chosen within this Y Distance.

ignore_visibility.title: Ignore Visibility
ignore_visibility.description: Whether or not to ignore direct line of sight while this entity is running away from other specified entities.

max_dist.title: Max Dist
max_dist.description: Maximum distance to look for an avoid target for the entity.

max_flee.title: Max Flee
max_flee.description: How many blocks away from its avoid target the entity must be for it to stop fleeing from the avoid target.

on_escape_event.title: Escape Event
on_escape_event.description:
Event that is triggered when escaping from a mob.

Properties:
• event (string) = 
• filters ({ domain, operator, subject, ... }) = {"AND":null,"NOT":nu
• target (string) = self

defaultSnippets.label: Entity ActorDefinitionTrigger
defaultSnippets.description: Triggers an entity event when specified conditions are met. Events activate component groups that change entity behavior—transforming villagers into zombie villagers, switching mobs to aggressive mode, or triggering growth stages. Combine with filters to create conditional state machines that respond to gameplay.

probability_per_strength.title: Probability Per Strength
probability_per_strength.description: Percent chance this entity will stop avoiding another entity based on that entity's strength, where 1.0 = 100%.

remove_target.title: Remove Target
remove_target.description: Determine if we should remove target when fleeing or not.

river_speed_multiplier.title: River Speed Multiplier
river_speed_multiplier.description: Multiplier for speed when following river. 1.0 means keep the regular speed, while higher numbers make the speed faster.

sound_interval.title: Sound Interval
sound_interval.description:
The range of time in seconds to randomly wait before playing the sound again.

Properties:
• max (float) = 0
• min (float) = 0

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components FloatRange
defaultSnippets.description: Has minimum and maximum float values.

sprint_distance.title: Sprint Distance
sprint_distance.description: How many blocks within range of its avoid target the entity must be for it to begin sprinting away from the avoid target.

sprint_speed_multiplier.title: Sprint Speed Multiplier
sprint_speed_multiplier.description: Multiplier for sprint speed. 1.0 means keep the regular speed, while higher numbers make the sprint speed faster.

walk_speed_multiplier.title: Walk Speed Multiplier

minecraft:is_collidable.title: Minecraft Is Collidable
minecraft:is_collidable.description:
Allows other mobs to have vertical and horizontal collisions with this mob. For a collision to occur, both mobs must have a "minecraft:collision_box" component. This component can only be used on mobs and enables collisions exclusively between mobs.
Please note that this type of collision is unreliable for moving collidable mobs. It is recommended to use this component only in scenarios where the collidable mob remains stationary.
Collidable behavior is closely related to stackable behavior. While the "minecraft:is_collidable" component governs how other mobs interact with the component's owner, the "minecraft:is_stackable" component describes how an entity interacts with others of its own kind.

entity_actor_document.description: The root structure for entity behavior definitions in behavior packs. Contains the entity's unique identifier, components that define its capabilities, component groups for state variations, and events that trigger state changes. Every custom mob, NPC, or creature requires an actor document defining its AI, health, movement, and interactions.
